name: Berlin tenant and employee rights community of practice

mentions.name: Berlin tenant and employee rights community of practice
mentions.description: A community of practice around tenant and employee rights in Berlin, bringing experts and contributors into the same room so they can work faster and together, and making research easier by letting members ask experts directly (e.g., via WhatsApp).
mentions.audience: Experts working on tenant and employee rights in Berlin
mentions.source_excerpt: Concretely, I'm setting up a community of practice around the topic. I'm putting everyone in the same room so that we can work faster and together. It makes research much easier for me, because I can just ask experts on Whatsapp.

evidence.value: Concretely, I'm setting up a community of practice around the topic. I'm putting everyone in the same room so that we can work faster and together. It makes research much easier for me, because I can just ask experts on Whatsapp.
